title: Cognitive Biases
summary: Cognitive biases are systematic shortcuts that distort judgement.

key_concepts.explanation: Favouring information that agrees with what we already believe.
Relying too heavily on the first number we hear.

outline.heading: Why biases arise
points: The mind saves effort with heuristics.
Heuristics work well in familiar settings.

assignments.task: Keep a decision diary for one week

questions: Can you think of a time anchoring affected a purchase?
